name: Loved by villagers
description: You are a great merchant, villagers will have better prices for you.

actions.command: execute at @s as @e[type=villager,distance=..7] run data merge entity @s {Gossips:[{Target:[I;1,1,1,1],Type:'major_positive',Value:110}]}
execute at @s as @e[type=villager,distance=..7] run data modify entity @s Gossips[{Target:[I;1,1,1,1]}].Target set from entity @p UUID
